Port Moody market context, June to September 2026

Port Moody had 135 houses and 192 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 15 and 29 sold in the month. Lots and land are a smaller part of those listings, so the market-wide figures below are the closest published read on the price pressure around them.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

items.t: Port Moody real estate market stats

faq.q: Is Port Moody a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Port Moody had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many lots and land are for sale in Port Moody?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the lots and land in Port Moody that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when lots and land come up in Port Moody?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Port Moody homes?
faq.a: The Port Moody homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Port Moody market stats page has the monthly figures.
